Problem: For which natural number \( K \) does the expression \(\frac{n^{2}}{1.001^{n}}\) reach its maximum value?

<reflection>
The goal is to find the natural number K that maximizes f(n)=n^2/1.001^n. f(n) is defined for natural numbers n.
For small n, 1.001^n is close to 1, so f(n) is approximately n^2 and does not tend to zero; f(n) tends to zero only as n→∞.
Use the ratio f(n+1)/f(n) to determine where the sequence stops increasing and starts decreasing.
</reflection>
